text: Six weeks to Christmas, and both signals point at the same house. Google searches for all four are a little above their usual level, with Byredo the highest. On Wikipedia, Byredo is running well ahead of its season while the other three lag. The data can’t say why yet. In Google searches, the classic names have out-lifted the cult houses every December since 2018; if Byredo keeps this up, this could be the first year that changes.
